successors.deliverable: Run existing batch01-selectors.spec.ts and batch14-async-busy.spec.ts on one frozen docs-owned fixture host. Prioritize disabled-ID keyboard/form/focus, local filtering/duplicate labels, out-of-order host results, selected-record retention and busy/retry isolation; include reset/direction only where no equivalent matching native receipt exists. Save raw results/host/source/output hashes.
